text: Hello and welcome to live coverage of the Premier League clash between Fulham and Luton Town at Craven Cottage.
Fulham have collected four points from their opening four games in the Premier League and are still searching for their first home win of the new campaign.
Marco Silva’s men opened the season with an away win over Everton but were thrashed by Brentford and Manchester City either side of a draw with Arsenal.
Despite the poor run of results, the Cottagers will have been boosted by the news of midfielders Joao Palhinha & Harrison Reed signing new contracts.
The hosts are also unbeaten in their last five games versus Luton (winning three and drawing two), triumphing in both of their home matches in that run (3-2 in October 2019, 7-0 in May 2022).
Luton have had a tough start to life in the Premier League and are one of two teams yet to register a point.
The Hatters began their campaign with two away fixtures because of developments to Kenilworth Road, with Rob Edwards' side losing by three goals to Brighton and Hove Albion and Chelsea.
They then welcomed West Ham before the international break, looking to make an impression in front of their home fans, but lost 2-1.
Jarrod Bowen and Kurt Zouma put the visitors in a commanding position, with Mads Andersen scoring a consolation in stoppage time.
Luton will want to avoid making unwanted history today, as they have only lost their first four fixtures on two occasions (1927-28 and 2002-03, both in the third tier).
Fulham make three changes to the side that were thumped by Manchester City in their previous outing.
Palhina was absent from the last squad after his transfer deadline day move collapsed, but he is back and starts ahead of Cairney in the midfield.
New signing Castagne replaces Antonee Robinson at left-back, with Willian also making an appearance on the wing.
Decordova-Reed drops to the bench.
As for Luton, manager Rob Edwards makes four alterations to the team that was beaten by West Ham before the international break.
Kabore replaces Doughty on the right side of the defence, with captain Lockyer coming into the middle.
Bell retains his place but moves over to the left, meaning that Giles misses out.
Arsenal loanee Lokonga makes his debut and is preferred ahead of Barkley in the midfield, with the final switch coming in the attack.
Brown takes Adebayo’s place next to Morris.
Fulham have only won two of their last eight Premier League home games (drawing two and losing four), and haven’t kept a clean sheet in any of those matches, shipping 16 goals (two per game).

They lost this season’s home opener 0-3 to Brentford; only in 1951-52 and 2020-21 (first three) have the Cottagers ever lost their first two home matches in a top-flight season, going on to be relegated in both such campaigns.
Luton get this Premier League clash under way.
Chong with the first kick.
Luton have shown that they want to launch the ball up the pitch in the first couple of minutes.
Morris tries to bring it down under pressure from Ream, but the ball escapes his control.
Kabore fouls Willian on the left and gives away a free-kick in a crossing position.
Burke clears it away and Chong has the ability to break away, but he does not have any support around him as he moves into Fulham's box.
He drives a shot towards the bottom corner, with Leno making a simple save.
Wilson has possession just inside Fulham's half and chips a pass over the top of Luton's defence to Castagne, who wins a corner.
The hosts play it short, but it goes wrong after a heavy touch from Reed.
Goal-kick to Luton.
Kaminski runs off his line and tries to clear the ball away, but his attempt is poor and it goes straight to Pereira.
The midfielder looks to get it under control and get a shot away.
However, Lockyer puts him under pressure and deals with it well.
Tete is marked by two Luton players next to the byline and pokes it to Jimenez just inside the box.
The striker then flashes a cross into the heart of the area, but nobody is there to receive it.
Willian has space on the left flank and considers a cross before laying a pass back to Palhinha.
He shapes to shoot on the edge of the box, but Nakamba is aware of the danger and rushes to him to block his effort.
Luton are doing their best to stop Willian moving into space on the left flank.
He is put under pressure by two players every time that he receives possession, forcing him to play a pass back rather than drive into the box.
Diop slides a pass down the right flank to Tete, who delivers a curling cross into the box from a deep position.
Jimenez gets under it and tries to head the ball back across the box, but Luton clear it away.
Luton have struggled to make an impact in the attacking third this game.
Kabore moves into Fulham's half after dribbling past Jimenez.
However, Palhinha gets across and pokes the ball away.
Tete is being given a lot of space on the right flank and receives possession again after a switch from Ream.
His cross is touched into the path of Jimenez by Willian, but his overhead kick is cleared away.
OVER! Tete has Fulham's best chance of the game.
Pereira's curling cross has pace on it, allowing Tete to escape Nakamba and flick a header towards the goal.
However, he gets too much on it, with the ball going just over the bar.
Fulham win a free-kick in a shooting position after Lokonga makes a late tackle on Wilson.
The Wales international and Pereira are over it, with the latter directing his effort straight at Kaminski.
Brown has a chance to break into Fulham's half after escaping a couple of tackles.
He pulls his leg back and is about to slide a throughball into the path of Morris, but Palhinha gets back to make an impressive tackle.
This is the first top-flight meeting between Fulham and Luton since the 1959-60 campaign.
The Cottagers won 4-2 at home in September, while the Hatters won 4-1 at Kenilworth Road in January that season.
WIDE! What a chance for Luton.
Kabore holds onto the ball before spreading a pass out to Kabore on the right.
The right-back finds Morris with a cross, who receives the ball again after making the most of a poor clearance from Diop.
He has space inside the box but shoots wide.
POST! Another chance for Luton.
Kabore sends another inviting cross into the box from the right.
Brown is free in the middle and has the entire goal to aim at from close range, but he crashes the post.
Chong is shown the first yellow card of the game for simulation.
Fulham have shown that they can be exposed defensively.
Luton have been put under pressure for the majority of the game but should have scored from one of their two clear opportunities.
Luton look to break away from a Fulham free-kick.
Chong collects possession on the left before moving inside and playing a pass to Morris.
He then attempts to switch the play over to the right, but Willian gets back to make the interception.
Kabore has been causing a lot of issues down the right side of the pitch.
This time he wrestles with Castagne and wins possession before a free-kick is given.
Fulham are showing signs of frustration and are going more direct with their passes.
Palhinha's direct attempt goes straight to Kaminski.
Luton think they have it back, but a free-kick is given to the hosts after Bell blocks Wilson's path.
Wilson's second free-kick of the game curls just wide of the target.
Kaminski takes his time with the following goal-kick and is shown a yellow card.
Palhinha fouls Lokonga just inside Luton's half.
The away crowd then make a loud cheer, suggesting that they have not been rewarded many free-kicks in this fixture.
Castagne is the first Fulham player to go into the book after crashing into Kabore on the right.
His shoulder collides with the right-back, who is still down.
Kabore is back to his feet after being given medial treatment.
He wants to be allowed back onto the pitch straight away for the free-kick, but the referee disagrees.
Reed then heads it away on the edge of the box.
Pereira's dangerous free-kick from the right is flicked across the box by Castagne.
Ream runs over to the right to keep the attack alive before being tackled.
Diop is now in the book after a foul on Brown.
Lokonga's free-kick goes over everyone before being recovered by a Fulham player.
Morris goes down after colliding with Reed inside the box.
He wants a penalty but nothing is given.
There will be two minutes of additional time.
HALF-TIME: FULHAM 0-0 LUTON TOWN
Fulham dominated possession in the first half, but it was Luton who went the closest to scoring before the break.
The visitors had two clear opportunities inside two minutes, with Morris and Brown failing to test Leno.
Kabore was the architect of both after supplying dangerous crosses from the right.
Morris got onto the end of the first cross, with the ball returning to him after a poor clearance from Diop.
He had space inside the box but blasted his low effort wide.
Brown then went close to netting on his first start, but his header crashed against the post.
The hosts found it difficult to break into Luton's box.
Tete headed just over, with Wilson failing to score from two free-kicks.
Fulham completed 392 passes before the break but didn't create many scoring opportunities.
Luton have defended their box well and have not let Wilson, Willian or Pereira have any time in possession.
Tete has been their best player.
He has been able to deliver a couple of quality crosses into the box, but they have not been converted.
As for the visitors, they have shown that they can defend and attack in the Premier League after a couple of tough away trips.
They have counted with quality after being put under pressure but must show a clinical edge if they want to score.
Fulham get the ball rolling again.
They will be hoping that they will be able to create more chances to score after dominating possession before the break.
No changes for either side.
Ream has possession just inside Fulham's half and looks to curl a pass down the left channel to Pereira.
However, he puts too much on it and the ball rolls out for a goal-kick.
Willian hits the floor after Kaboré steps on him.
There was a moment of concern for the winger, who gets back on his feet soon after.
SAVE! Luton should have the lead.
Brown has the ball inside Fulham's box and flashes a cross into a dangerous position.
Bell makes a darting run into space and directs a shot towards the goal, but it goes straight at Leno.
Jimenez has failed to make an impact on the game so far.
He remains without a goal in the Premier League since the start of last season, attempting 27 shots in 19 appearances without scoring in this time.
His expected goals total of 3.0 is the highest of any player without a goal in the division since the beginning of 2022-23.
OVER! Pereira's corner from the left is punched away by Kaminski.
Castagne recovers the ball and sends an inviting cross onto the head of Palhinha, but his looping attempt goes just over.
Jimenez is tripped by Lockyer on the edge of the box and wants a free-kick, but the referee allows the game to continue with Fulham in possession.
Willian has it on the left and looks to beat Burke, but the defender makes the tackle.
Diop sends a smart pass inside to Willian, who turns on the ball before sending it out to Tete on the right.
He looks to slide the ball down the right, but his attempt is intercepted.
Fulham are still being frustrated by Fulham.
However, they are moving the ball around with pace and are showing more intent.
Tete and Reed play a quick one-two on the right before the right-back curls a low cross into the box.
It is cleared away to Castagne on the edge, who has an attempt blocked by Burke.
Reed finds Tete with a short pass down the right flank.
He then sends a cross into the box, but it is too high, allowing Kaminski to claim it with ease.
Pereira and Willian combine with a few passes before the latter cuts inside with possession.
The former Chelsea man looks to drill a low shot into the bottom corner from outside the box, but Burke makes the block.

events.action: drill a low shot into the bottom corner

text: Reed comes off after an energetic performance in the midfield.
New signing Iwobi takes his place.
Silva also makes a switch in the attack.
Jimenez had just 21 touches and is replaced by Vinicius.

Fulham have only lost one of their last eight Premier League matches against newly promoted opposition at Craven Cottage (winning three and drawing four), going down 1-2 to Leeds United in March 2021.
They have controlled most of the game but have given Luton three clear chances to score.
GOALLLL! VINICIUS SCORES! 1-0 FULHAM! What an impact from the substitute.
Willian receives possession on the left and goes past Kabore before sending a low cross into the box.
Kaminski pushes it straight into the path of the Vinicius, who blasts his shot into the net.

events.action: blasts his shot into the net

text: Luton will have to show more attacking intent after conceding.
Bell has had their only opportunities to score since half-time.
WIDE! Fulham have the momentum in the game and go close to scoring a second.
Iwobi and Pereira combine on the edge of the box before the latter sends a pass out to Willian.
He looks to shoot from a tight angle, with his effort deflecting just wide.
Iwobi has had an impact on the game since coming on as a substitute.
He has constantly looked to receive possession and is clearly looking to make an impression in front of his new fans.
Willian has Kabore ahead of him and thinks about going past him before playing a pass across to Palhinha.
The Portugal international shapes to shoot from distance and curls his effort just over the bar.
Luton make four changes to try and alter the outcome of the game.
Brown is the first striker to come off and is replaced by Doughty.
He went close to scoring earlier in the game, hitting the post with a header.
Morris also makes his way off.
Ogbene comes on in the attack.
Lokonga has had a busy game at the heart of Luton's midfield.
Mpanzu takes his place.
Adebayo is the fourth substitute to come on at the same time.
Chong has been bright in spells but is now given a rest.
Doughty's free-kick from the left is cleared away by the head of Castagne.
The clearance was vital because Andersen was right behind him.
Mpanzu drives a pass into the feet of Burke inside Fulham's box, who looks to have space to shoot.
However, he cannot sort his feet out, allowing a couple of defenders to get around him and poke it out for a corner.
Fulham make a couple of changes.
Wilson makes his way off the pitch and is replaced by Cordova-Reid.
Pereira is also replaced.
Cairney is given the final nine minutes to make an impression.
Luton make their final change of the game.
Woodrow comes on against his former side to add an extra man into the attack, with Burke coming off.
Kabore receives the ball inside Fulham's box and touches the ball out of his feet before seeing his shot deflect wide of the post.
Palhinha is usually patient in possession but goes direct with a pass, sending the ball over to Tete on the right.
The full-back then plays it back to Iwobi on the edge of the box, who shoots over.
Woodrow looks to make an impression off the bench but heads the ball just wide.
Tete moves into the middle of Luton's half and sends a throughball into the path of Vinicius.
The striker tries to go around the goalkeeper but his touch is loose.
He then goes the other way to try and make space for a shot.
However, Lockyer makes an impressive tackle.
Fulham are dominating the game at the moment, with Luton struggling to get out of their own half.
The hosts are showing patience with the ball and are looking to slow the game down.
Willian does not have a goal or an assist to his name but comes off to a loud applause after an impressive performance on the left side of the attack.
Bassey makes his first appearance since his red card against Arsenal.
Cairney and Iwobi are free down the left side of the pitch and have a chance to put a cross into the box.
However, with just two minutes left of the game, they decide to keep possession.
Kabore sends in a cross from the right side of the pitch.
Lockyer makes contact with the ball after it goes over the head of Bassey, but his attempt goes well wide.
Tete goes towards the corner flag and wins a free-kick.
It is only a matter of time before the game comes to an end.
FULL-TIME: FULHAM 1-0 LUTON TOWN
Vinicius scored three minutes after coming off the bench to help Fulham beat Luton.
The Cottagers dominated possession before the break, but it was Luton who had the better opportunities to score.
Morris blasted a shot just wide of the post from close range before Brown crashed the post with a header.
Bell then had a massive chance soon after the restart after receiving a cross from Brown, but his effort went straight at Leno.
The hosts then controlled the rest of the game.
Palhinha's looping header went just over, with Vinicius netting the crucial goal.
Willian was causing havoc down the left throughout the game and burst past Kabore before sending the ball across the box.
Kaminski tried to push it away.
However, he could only find Vinicius, who crashed his shot in.
Fulham collected their first win in three Premier League games after a narrow win over Luton.
They travel to Crytal Palace in their next Premier League fixture before facing Norwich City in the third round of the EFL Cup.
As for the Hatters, they have now lost all four of their games since being promoted from the Championship.
Next up, they host Wolves, who have lost three of their four matches.
That's all for today, goodbye.
